header: Six people who will sit down with you for an hour
lead: Aubruck runs the district's mentoring scheme for people retraining into surveying. An hour, on a Wednesday afternoon, free, and you do not have to be applying to us.
note: Sessions run from October to June. Mentors without a button are fully booked for this term rather than gone — try again after the spring intake.
